key_finding: min(eta_max) and min(K_eff) converge to identical panels in most conditions. Both select low-vulnerability, high-agreement panels (API frontier models). The hypothesis that min(K_eff) > min(eta_max) at K=5 is not supported — they are equivalent because low eta_max and low K_eff are correlated.
